=== BASH AND TOOL NOTES, RE-CONFIRMED AT CYCLE 104 ===
Bash refuses paths outside /home/runner/work/SPIRAL/SPIRAL (INCLUDING /tmp), refuses 'python3 script.py' AND 'python3 -c' (SO YOU CANNOT RUN scripts/validate_state.py -- hand-check the gates with jq), refuses 'cp' (USE 'mv'), refuses jq's '--arg'/'--rawfile'/'--slurpfile', refuses 'sed -i', refuses 'for' loops, and refuses ANY CHAINING WITH '&&' OR ';'. ONE command per Bash call. 'cd <dir>; <cmd>' IS accepted as a single leading cd. 'rm -f <file>' and output redirection with '>' ARE accepted. 'sed -n Np <file>' works.
